articles.headline: Oppn files plea against CEC; thousands join march to SC
articles.blurb: I.N.D.I.A leaders and supporters marched in New Delhi to the Supreme Court to file a plea against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter-list irregularities; police did not interfere as on previous days, and the court is to hear the plea soon.

articles.headline: No more protests at Jantar Mantar; 3 new sites named
articles.blurb: Delhi Police have barred protests at Jantar Mantar and designated three alternative sites—Rohini/Bawana, CBD Ground East District and Burari Ground North District—for demonstrations.

articles.headline: K'taka High Court strikes down 56% quota for SC/ST
articles.blurb: The Karnataka High Court struck down the 2022 amendment raising Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe reservations to 56%, holding it unconstitutional for breaching the Supreme Court's 50% ceiling on quotas.

articles.headline: Challenge ruling in SC: Bommai
articles.blurb: Former chief minister Basavaraj Bommai said the BJP will challenge the High Court order on SC/ST quotas in the Supreme Court.

articles.headline: Sudha Yadav new Governor of K'taka
articles.blurb: Senior BJP leader Sudha Yadav was appointed Governor of Karnataka, succeeding Thawar Chand Gehlot.

articles.headline: Food, fuel push retail inflation to 23-month high of 5.54%
articles.blurb: Retail inflation hit a 23-month high of 5.54% as food prices—including vegetables such as tomatoes and lemons—and fuel-linked transport costs rose sharply.

articles.headline: Centre's air quality survey methodology flawed, says IISc study
articles.blurb: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Science said the Centre's Swachh Vayu Survekshan ranks cities on process steps rather than actual PM10 outcomes, producing misleading air-quality scores.

articles.headline: Rs 9k cr sanctioned for Konkan Railway: Somanna
articles.blurb: Union Minister V Somanna said ₹9,000 crore has been sanctioned for Konkan Railway works on the route serving coastal Karnataka.

articles.headline: US economists Hall, Woodford win Nobel for work on inflation, output gaps
articles.blurb: Americans Robert E Hall of Stanford and Michael Woodford of Columbia won the 2026 Nobel in Economic Sciences for research on how households and firms form expectations and how that shapes monetary policy and stabilisation after shocks.

articles.headline: 33k state voters 'ineligible' for final rolls
articles.blurb: Karnataka's special summary revision found about 33,000 voters ineligible for the final electoral roll after hearings statewide.

articles.headline: Protesters detained in B'luru
articles.blurb: Police detained protesters marching toward KR Circle in Bengaluru demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner over the voter-roll revision.

articles.headline: Northeast monsoon likely in next 2-3 days: IMD
articles.blurb: The India Meteorological Department said the northeast monsoon is likely to set in over southern peninsular India within two to three days.

articles.headline: Airbase plot 'directed' by Iran Guards: UK PM
articles.blurb: UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak said a foiled plot against a British airbase was almost certainly directed by Iran's Revolutionary Guards.

articles.headline: Four Pak terrorists killed in mine blast
articles.blurb: Four Pakistani terrorists were killed in a landmine explosion near the Line of Control in Poonch district of Jammu and Kashmir while attempting an infiltration.

articles.headline: Two from Mandya varsity die in Kerala accident
articles.blurb: Two students from a Mandya university died when their van collided with a lorry in Kerala.

articles.headline: Difficult to meet TN's Cauvery demand: K'taka
articles.blurb: Karnataka told the Supreme Court it cannot meet Tamil Nadu's Cauvery water demand in a rain-deficit year and asked how backlog could be cleared.

articles.headline: FESTIVE LIGHTS
articles.blurb: K R Circle in Mysuru was illuminated for Dasara festivities on Monday, as shown in a night photograph from the city.

articles.headline: What do architecture courses lack? (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Ali Khwaja writes that B.Arch programmes face falling demand and a gap between NATA-driven admissions and industry needs such as project management and specialised design fields.

articles.headline: The other side of exam malpractice (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Darshan B M argues invigilators and institutions must use evidence-based, proportionate penalties for malpractice to protect honest students and ensure fair process.

articles.headline: Making workplaces work for women (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Anitha Ramachander cites hiring bias, leadership gaps and the 'double burden' of work and home, urging flexible policies and unbiased recruitment to retain women professionals.

articles.headline: Teaching history the right way (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Himesh Ved critiques NCERT's Grade 9 social science textbook changes and calls for history teaching that builds critical thinking rather than rote memorisation.

articles.headline: IIIT-B invites applications for research programmes
articles.blurb: IIIT Bangalore is inviting applications for integrated PhD, full-time PhD and MS (Research) with stipends of ₹20,000–₹31,000; the deadline is November 9, 2026.

articles.headline: UVCE seeks Physical Education Director-cum-Yoga Teacher
articles.blurb: University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering, Bengaluru, advertised one temporary full-time post requiring M.P.Ed/M.P.E with NET/SLET/PhD and yoga certification; applications close October 21, 2026.

articles.headline: Ivan asks Cong workers to prioritise SIR, Bharat Jodo membership drive
articles.blurb: MLC Ivan D'Souza told Congress workers in Mangaluru South to focus on the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the Bharat Jodo Yuva Sangha membership drive.

articles.headline: Students protest against college opposing UG semester exams during Dasara
articles.blurb: Students of St Agnes College (Autonomous), backed by ABVP, protested undergraduate semester exams scheduled during Dasara; the college postponed papers set for October 19 and 22.

articles.headline: NSUI urges colleges to reschedule exams
articles.blurb: NSUI called on colleges to reschedule examinations that clash with Dasara holidays so students can observe the festival.

articles.headline: Respect students' sentiments: MLA
articles.blurb: Former minister U T Khader said colleges should respect students' sentiments and avoid scheduling exams during Navaratri and Dasara.

articles.headline: Citing drought, forums urge buffalo owners to stay away from Mysuru Kambala
articles.blurb: Farmers' and environmental forums in Dakshina Kannada and Udupi asked buffalo owners not to take part in Mysuru Kambala, citing drought stress on animals and the venue.

articles.headline: Vaishakh Rai, Nikhil Muddappa, Zeeshan shine at autocross race
articles.blurb: Vaishakh Rai, Nikhil Muddappa and Zeeshan were among winners at the Bharat Petroleum Autocross Race at Goldfinch City Grounds in Kulur.

articles.headline: Koragas stage semi-nude protest seeking title deeds
articles.blurb: Koraga community members marched semi-nude to the Deputy Commissioner's office in Padil, Mangaluru, demanding title deeds and house sites promised earlier.

articles.headline: Man murders wife
articles.blurb: A man stabbed his 30-year-old wife to death at Ullal near Mangaluru; police registered a murder case.

articles.headline: Deeksharambha 2026 held
articles.blurb: Yenepoya Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences College held its Deeksharambha 2026 orientation for new students.

articles.headline: Training in mushroom cultivation held
articles.blurb: Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Dakshina Kannada, organised mushroom cultivation training for farmers at Vamanjoor.

articles.headline: AERA to hold tariff consultation for Mangaluru airport
articles.blurb: The Airports Economic Regulatory Authority scheduled a stakeholders' meeting on October 15, 2026, on aeronautical tariffs for Mangaluru International Airport for the second control period 2024–2031.

articles.headline: 25 Cong MLAs, ministers, will join BJP before polls: BYV
articles.blurb: State BJP president B Y Vijayendra claimed about 25 Congress MLAs, including ministers, will defect to the BJP before the next elections.

articles.headline: Post 42.29 lakh hearings, 33,547 voters found 'ineligible'
articles.blurb: After 42.29 lakh hearings in Karnataka's voter-roll revision, 33,547 names were deleted as ineligible; the final list is to be published on October 27.

articles.headline: 180 names deleted in Davangere district
articles.blurb: Davangere district officials removed 180 voters from rolls during the special intensive revision after hearings.

articles.headline: Govt officials canvassing for Cong MLC candidate: NDA
articles.blurb: The NDA complained to the chief electoral officer that education department officials were campaigning for a Congress candidate in the Bengaluru Teachers' MLC constituency.

articles.headline: Anti-CEC protesters hit B'luru roads, detained
articles.blurb: Protesters demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over the SIR exercise were detained on Seshadri Road in Bengaluru.

articles.headline: Clarification from police
articles.blurb: Bengaluru City Police said detentions during the anti-CEC protest followed due process and were made to prevent law-and-order disruption.

articles.headline: South K'taka Postal region office to be shifted to Mysuru
articles.blurb: Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje announced the South Karnataka postal region headquarters will move from Bengaluru to Mysuru.

articles.headline: Will urge CM to drop Bedti river linking projects, says Deshpande
articles.blurb: Congress leader R V Deshpande said he will ask the chief minister to drop Bedti river-linking proposals that could harm Uttara Kannada's environment.

articles.headline: DK child protection unit to probe sexual abuse charge against church priest
articles.blurb: The Dakshina Kannada District Child Protection Unit is investigating allegations that a church priest sexually abused a minor girl.

articles.headline: HDK demands probe into alleged sting op against Siddu
articles.blurb: Union Minister H D Kumaraswamy demanded a full investigation into an alleged sting operation targeting former chief minister Siddaramaiah.

articles.headline: 'Dragging CJI into politics inappropriate'
articles.blurb: Kumaraswamy criticised Rahul Gandhi's suggestion of meeting the Chief Justice of India on political matters as lacking political maturity.

articles.headline: KSRTC's B'luru-Mysuru holiday package tours
articles.blurb: KSRTC is running 'Ashwamedha Classic' holiday packages from Bengaluru to Mysuru between October 13 and 28, covering Srirangapatna, Mysuru Palace, zoo, Chamundi Hills and other stops.

articles.headline: JUMBOS ON A STROLL
articles.blurb: Dasara elephants walked through illuminated Mysuru streets on Monday ahead of the festival.

articles.headline: Cauvery: Difficult to meet TN's demand on shortfall, K'taka tells SC
articles.blurb: Karnataka told a Supreme Court bench including Justices Vikram Nath and Ahsanuddin Amanullah it cannot supply Tamil Nadu's share in a deficient monsoon year and questioned how arrears could be cleared.

articles.headline: Two men assaulted, peed in mouth in Talikote
articles.blurb: Two men were assaulted by a group of five people in Vijayapura's Talikote, with one victim forced to drink urine; police registered cases.

articles.headline: India crosses milestone in renewable energy
articles.blurb: India's renewable electricity generation crossed 100 billion units in a single quarter for the first time, official data showed.

articles.headline: HC ruling on quota: Bommai tells govt to move SC
articles.blurb: Former CM Basavaraj Bommai urged the state government to appeal the High Court verdict striking down increased SC/ST quotas in the Supreme Court.

articles.headline: One nation, 'one protest': Rahul on parallel stirs
articles.blurb: LoP Rahul Gandhi said opposition parties are receiving information from officials about alleged PM and HM instructions to the CEC, and called heavy Delhi policing a sign the government fears the protests.

articles.headline: No adjudication on new Form 6, says Supreme Court
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court clarified it had approved the SIR process but not ruled on the new Form 6 voter-registration form, which remains disputed.

articles.headline: Congress 'frustrated & desperate', says Chouhan
articles.blurb: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan accused the Congress of attacking constitutional bodies such as the Election Commission to hide electoral setbacks.

articles.headline: CJP approaches police for fresh date to protest at Jantar Mantar
articles.blurb: Citizens for Justice and Peace sought a new protest date after being denied permission to demonstrate at Jantar Mantar.

articles.headline: BJP hits out at Congress over demand for CJI's resignation
articles.blurb: The BJP accused the Congress of trying to create anarchy by demanding the Chief Justice of India's resignation.

articles.headline: 'Not my domain': CJI on Delhi protest situation, curbs
articles.blurb: Chief Justice Surya Kant said managing protest-related traffic curbs is the executive's domain, not the judiciary's.

articles.headline: Ramlila Maidan booked till Dec, protest costs Rs 1.21L
articles.blurb: Ramlila Maidan is booked for events through December and hiring it for a day costs about ₹1.21 lakh, limiting protest venues in Delhi.

articles.headline: Keralam Assembly passes resolution seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal
articles.blurb: The Kerala Legislative Assembly passed a resolution calling for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's removal over voter-list issues.

articles.headline: Punjab final roll shows 13.6 lakh fewer voters after SIR
articles.blurb: Punjab's final electoral roll after SIR lists 13.6 lakh fewer voters, a 6.23% drop from the draft.

articles.headline: Plea in SC opposes contempt petition over traffic-and-transit curbs
articles.blurb: A counter-plea in the Supreme Court argued peaceful protest rights should not be overridden solely by traffic concerns during Delhi demonstrations.

articles.headline: Sting operations: It's time for truth (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The editorial says Karnataka's latest sting allegations involving top leaders need a credible independent inquiry, warning that claims without formal probes become political theatre.

articles.headline: US curbs and the case for homegrown innovation (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Gurucharan Gollekeri argues tighter US H-1B rules should push India to strengthen domestic R&D and universities so talent can build careers at home.

articles.headline: Retirement brought home a lesson (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Brig Aditya Madan recounts how civilian retirement taught him the unending domestic labour his wife had carried without army staff support.

articles.headline: Powering peace in times of strife (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The piece profiles South African jurist Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay's work on apartheid and international criminal justice after her Nobel Peace Prize recognition.

articles.headline: Bedti-Varada's test of equity (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Rajeshwari U R warns the Bedti-Varada river-link project must weigh ecological losses in the Western Ghats and livelihood impacts on local communities.

articles.headline: Accept failure and initiate remedial measures (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Hemachandra Basappa of Bengaluru writes that political parties should admit failures and fix governance instead of deflecting blame.

articles.headline: Save forests (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Shreedhar S Vani of Koppal urges halting forest land diversion that threatens biodiversity and tribal rights.

articles.headline: Weaponising procedure (Opinion)
articles.blurb: K Chidanand Kumar of Bengaluru argues electoral procedures are being used to disenfranchise voters and demands transparent roll revision.

articles.headline: The arithmetic of by-poll victories and the questions of electoral fairness (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Subhanjoy Maitra analyses how by-election arithmetic in West Bengal and Bihar shapes perceptions of electoral fairness in Indian democracy.

articles.headline: Taliban are using Europe's fear of migrants to their advantage
articles.blurb: European governments seeking Taliban help to deport rejected Afghan asylum seekers are leveraging migration fears despite condemning the regime's rights record.

articles.headline: Prasada is not a buffet (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Vijay Kanuru links ultra-processed diets and rising calorie intake to India's health crisis and calls for mindful eating akin to sacred prasada.

articles.headline: 95 perish in IA crash in Bombay
articles.blurb: Fifty years ago, 95 people died when an Indian Airlines Caravelle crashed at Mumbai's Santa Cruz airport in October 1976.

articles.headline: Nobel Peace Prize for UN, Annan
articles.blurb: Twenty-five years ago the Nobel Peace Prize went to the United Nations and Secretary-General Kofi Annan for advancing a more peaceful world.

articles.headline: Making the 'magic words' meaningful (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Suryakumari Dennison writes that teaching children please, thank you and sorry should build genuine empathy, not rote manners.

articles.headline: SC questions Centre on capping margins beyond anti-cancer drugs
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court asked why trade margins are capped at 30% for anti-cancer medicines while saline drips costing ₹11 are sold at ₹270, seeking a government plan by October 27.

articles.headline: Hyderabad family hit by tragedy on Umrah pilgrimage
articles.blurb: A Mehdipatnam family faced tragedy during Umrah in Saudi Arabia near Riyadh airport; AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi visited the bereaved relatives.

articles.headline: Top LeT man among four killed in Poonch minefield
articles.blurb: Four Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists, including commander Muhammad Faizaz, died in a mine blast while trying to cross the LoC in Poonch.

articles.headline: Northeast monsoon onset over southern peninsula likely in next 2-3 days: IMD
articles.blurb: IMD forecast the northeast monsoon to begin over southern India within days, with heavy rain expected over Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh.

articles.headline: US economists win Nobel for research on controlling energy crises, inflation
articles.blurb: Robert E Hall and Michael Woodford won the 2026 economics Nobel for showing how forward-looking household spending choices help central banks manage inflation and shocks.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia faces new attacks after major strikes on airports
articles.blurb: Houthi strikes disrupted Saudi airports and regional flights; the UAE called for renewed Gulf security cooperation.

articles.headline: Airbase plot 'almost certainly directed' by Iran Guards: UK
articles.blurb: The UK said a foiled plot against a British airbase was almost certainly ordered by Iran's Revolutionary Guards.

articles.headline: Bangladesh, China ink loan deal to modernise port near Indian border
articles.blurb: Bangladesh signed a $535.78 million Chinese Exim Bank loan to upgrade Mongla Port, raising Indian concerns over Beijing's footprint near the border.

articles.headline: Russia hitting energy sites despite truce claim: Ukraine
articles.blurb: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia continues striking Ukrainian power plants despite claims of a ceasefire.

articles.headline: US federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
articles.blurb: FBI and Homeland Security agents searched Representative Ilhan Omar's home as part of a federal investigation.

articles.headline: Over 100 foreign trekkers stranded in Nepal floods
articles.blurb: Flooding after a glacier collapse in central Nepal killed many people and left more than 100 foreign trekkers stranded.

articles.headline: Musk backs Republicans with $276mn donation
articles.blurb: Elon Musk donated about $276 million to Republican groups, becoming the largest disclosed donor to the coalition ahead of US midterms.

articles.headline: Pak places Imran Khan's party leaders in protective custody
articles.blurb: Pakistan detained several PTI leaders after emergency rule was imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

articles.headline: Pope to undergo lung surgery
articles.blurb: Pope Leo XIV is scheduled for surgery to remove a lung nodule, the Vatican announced.

articles.headline: Teen held over school shooting
articles.blurb: French police detained a 15-year-old who opened fire at a middle school in Aubagne, wounding two people.

articles.headline: Pak, Brazil hold defence talks
articles.blurb: Military chiefs of Pakistan and Brazil met in Rawalpindi to discuss bilateral defence cooperation.

articles.headline: Rupee jumps 93 paise to close at 95.78 against US dollar
articles.blurb: The rupee posted its biggest single-day gain in six months, closing at 95.78, helped by RBI steps including a 20% cash margin on forward import contracts above $2 million.

articles.headline: 'Banks seek RBI relief, clarity on latest rupee-defence steps'
articles.blurb: Banks asked the RBI to ease the 20% cash deposit rule on forwards and clarify treatment of smaller trades, with FEDAI joining the talks.

articles.headline: HCLTech Q2 net up 21% to Rs 5,132 cr
articles.blurb: HCLTech reported Q2 net profit of ₹5,132 crore, up 21% year on year, revenue of ₹35,620 crore, $3,258 million in new bookings and raised the lower end of FY27 revenue guidance to 2.5–4%.

articles.headline: Sunil Bharti Mittal conferred Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur
articles.blurb: France honoured Bharti Enterprises chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal with the Legion of Honour for his business and philanthropic work.

articles.headline: Puravankara signs JDA for Bengaluru housing project
articles.blurb: Puravankara signed a joint development agreement for a Bengaluru residential project with about ₹2,800 crore revenue potential.

articles.headline: Zetwerk fixes IPO price band at Rs 143-151
articles.blurb: Manufacturing platform Zetwerk set its IPO price band at ₹143–151 per share for an issue opening October 19, 2026.

articles.headline: Aequs signs long-term supply pacts with Safran
articles.blurb: Hubballi-based Aequs agreed long-term aerospace component supply deals with France's Safran.

articles.headline: GST Council to revisit ITC on motor vehicles
articles.blurb: The GST Council plans to re-examine input tax credit restrictions on motor vehicles used in business.

articles.headline: GE Aerospace to double India supply-chain spend to $400 mn by 2030
articles.blurb: GE Aerospace said it will raise India procurement to $400 million by 2030 from about $200 million now.

articles.headline: LTTS launches AI-Native E3 Lab with NVIDIA in Bengaluru
articles.blurb: L&T Technology Services opened an AI-native engineering lab in Bengaluru with NVIDIA for digital manufacturing.

articles.headline: Indian steel demand projected to expand by 7.9% in 2026, says worldsteel
articles.blurb: World Steel Association forecast India's steel demand at 158.2 million tonnes in 2026, up 7.9%.

articles.headline: Embattled United seek uplift
articles.blurb: Manchester United face Atletico Madrid in the Champions League seeking a morale boost after years of instability since Alex Ferguson's 2013 exit.

articles.headline: Isco sparkles in Betis romp
articles.blurb: Real Betis beat Sevilla to climb to fourth in La Liga, with Isco starring in the win.

articles.headline: Renshaw puts Aus on course for win
articles.blurb: Matt Renshaw's second-innings 62 helped Australia set South Africa 421 to win in Durban; the hosts were 102 for 4.

articles.headline: Plan to shackle Hope executed to perfection: Arshdeep
articles.blurb: Arshdeep Singh took three wickets in Indore as India beat West Indies in the third T20I to lead the series 2–1, saying the plan against Shai Hope worked.

articles.headline: Dhir relying on batting skills to make an impact with the ball
articles.blurb: Spin all-rounder Naman Dhir said his batting experience helps him read batsmen's intentions when bowling for India.

articles.headline: Tough opener for Sindhu
articles.blurb: P V Sindhu faces world No 1 An Se-young in the Denmark Open opener; Lakshya Sen also returns in men's singles.

articles.headline: Indian racing prodigy Atiqa joins reputed Kart Republic
articles.blurb: Nine-year-old Indian karter Atiqa Mir joined Kart Republic, the team that developed champions including Lewis Hamilton.

articles.headline: Yali wins feature event
articles.blurb: Yali won the feature race on the Hyderabad card on Monday's horse-racing programme.

articles.headline: UPW's Norris traded to MI
articles.blurb: UP Warriorz traded left-arm pacer Tara Norris to Mumbai Indians for the Women's Premier League.

articles.headline: No Europe Tour for LIV golfers
articles.blurb: Players who join LIV Golf in 2027 will not retain European Tour membership under new DP World Tour rules.

articles.headline: Powell, Rutherford reprimanded
articles.blurb: West Indies batters Rovman Powell and Sherfane Rutherford were reprimanded for ICC Code of Conduct breaches in the T20I against India.

articles.headline: Ministry-NSF Asiad review meet on Oct 15
articles.blurb: The Sports Ministry and National Sports Federations will review India's Asian Games performance on October 15.

articles.headline: Kushagra replaces Pant in India A squad
articles.blurb: Wicketkeeper Kumar Kushagra replaces rested Rishabh Pant in the India A squad.

articles.headline: Stride FC rise late for 3-0 win
articles.blurb: Stride FC scored late to win 3–0 in the KSFA Super Division League in Bengaluru.

articles.headline: Rahul, Revanth frustrate battling Karnataka
articles.blurb: Andhra's S V Rahul and Revanth Reddy batted steadily as Karnataka's inexperienced attack failed to press home advantage on day two of the Ranji Trophy opener in Mulapadu; Shikhar Shetty took 3 for 72.

articles.headline: Bergs' shocker for Alcaraz
articles.blurb: Zizou Bergs upset Carlos Alcaraz at the Shanghai Masters while Alexander Zverev advanced in the draw.

articles.headline: Samit shines with ball but Vidarbha hold firm
articles.blurb: Samit Dravid's bowling impressed for Karnataka U-19 against Vidarbha but the visitors stayed competitive.

articles.headline: Nitish, Dhruw power K'taka U-19 home
articles.blurb: Nitish and Dhruw led Karnataka Under-19 to victory over Bihar.

articles.headline: City set for Asia's top-tier women's basketball league
articles.blurb: Bengaluru will host the Women's Basketball League Asia; Deputy CM G Parameshwara and FIBA Asia president K Govindaraj unveiled the event on Monday.

articles.headline: Dhinidhi lone athlete from state for Youth Oly
articles.blurb: Swimmer Dhinidhi Desinghu is Karnataka's only qualifier for the Youth Olympics in Dakar.

articles.headline: Kashvi stars in Karnataka win
articles.blurb: Kashvi led Karnataka women's U-19 to victory with a strong all-round performance.

articles.headline: Yashaswini crashes out
articles.blurb: Karnataka's Yashaswini Ghorpade exited the National Ranking Table Tennis Championship.
